facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance reports that rollout of PFM Smart, a web-based and real-time accounting system replacing the councils' ex-post Petra application, was complete at Freetown City Council, with all transactions from January 2025 in the system and transactions processed live with payment instructions printed from it; the statement is undated within a report on January to June 2025, and the report does not say how the council is connected.

One local council of 22, Freetown City Council, was working live in the web-based PFM Smart system in the Ministry of Finance's report on January to June 2025, with five more councils planned before the end of 2025 and all 22 by 2026; the one council is the capital city.

systems.platform: web-based, real-time accounting system upgraded from the Petra Accounting application
systems.owner: Ministry of Finance, with support from the World Bank's Accountable Governance for Basic Service Delivery Project
systems.tiers: live at Freetown City Council; end-user training also given to Western Area Rural District Council in April 2025; planned for all 22 local councils from 2025 to 2026

systems.platform: Petra, an ex-post recording and reporting system

systems.owner: Accountant General's Department, Ministry of Finance
systems.tiers: over 90 ministries, departments and agencies; no local council is said to be on it

note: The two facts rest on a council processing transactions live in a web-based system; the report names no connection, its provider or who pays for it. The file is an excerpt cut off at the fetch limit, inside the section on local councils.
